Chapter 01 General 
 
1.1 总经理声明 
Declaration of the General Manager 
我公司依据《国际船舶安全营运和防止污染管理规则》的要求制定了《安全管理手册》。
它系统阐述了公司的安全管理体系及安全和环保方针、目标。是公司安全管理体系运
行的纲领性文件。 
Our company develops the Safety management Manual in accordance with the requirements of the 
International Management Code for the Safe Operation of Ships and for Pollution Prevention. The 
manual elaborates on the safety management system and the policy and object for safety and 
environmental protection of the company. It is the guideline for the implementation of the safety 
management system of the company. 
自2009 年4 月份开始，公司有领导、有组织、有计划地实施《国际船舶安全营运和防
止污染管理规则》，于2009 年4 月20 日，建立并运行符合公司特点的安全管理体系，
覆盖国际航行的船舶，适用于散货船。 
Since April, 2009, the company began to implement the International Management Code for the Safe 
Operation of Ships and for Pollution Prevention under regular leadership, organizations and plans. The 
company began to establish and operate its safety management system that falls into its characteristics on 
April 20, 2009, with a coverage of all its ships sailing international lines and suitable for its bulk carriers. 
1.1.1 高级领导层的承诺是做好安全管理工作的基础，公司的安全和防污染工作坚持“总经
理负第一位责任，指定人员负重要责任”的原则，督促各级领导重视各项安全和防污
染管理工作，强化安全和防污染管理的领导和责任。 
The promises of the top leaders are the basis for implementing well the safety management work. The 
safety and pollution prevention of the company adhere to the principle of the general manager bears 
the first responsibility and the designated person shoulders the chief responsibility to enforce the 
attention to the safety and pollution prevention from the leaders of various levels and enforce the 
leadership and responsibility in safety and pollution prevention.  
1.1.2 各级人员的责任心、能力、态度和主观能动性对船舶的安全和防污染起决定性作用，
公司领导要努力提高所有人员的责任心、能力和主观能动性，以主人翁的态度参与到
安全和防污染管理工作中。 
The sense of responsibility, ability, attitude and subjective initiative of the personnel of various levels 
play a leading role in the safety and pollution prevention of the ships. The leaders of the company shall 
make due efforts in improving the responsibility, ability and subjective initiatives of all the personnel 
and bring the personnel into the work of safety and pollution prevention with the attitude of an owner.

的理解和认识。  
Enforce the training of the personnel to ensure that the management personnel both on ship and 
shore-base will have due understanding and awareness of the ISM regulations and terms concerning 
their positions.

safety and environmental protection as the chief work.

1.4 
定义和缩写 
Definitions and abbreviations 
公司的安全管理体系采用的定义和缩写符合ISM 规则。涉及的主要定义或缩写明确
如下： 
The definitions and abbreviations of SMS of the company complies with the regulations of ISM. The 
main definitions and abbreviations concerned are defined as follows: 
1.4.1 国际安全管理规则－系指由国际海事组织大会通过的，并可由该组织予以修改的
《国际船舶安全营运和防止污染管理规则》，简称ISM 规则。 
The ISM Code: The International Management Code for the Safe Operation of Ships and for Pollution 
Prevention approved by the IMO meetings and can be revised by the organization, abbreviated as 
ISM Code. 
1.4.2 公司－系指青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司,为船舶管理人。该公司同意承担ISM
规则规定的所有义务和责任。 
Company: Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd, manager of the ships. The 
company agrees to bear all duties and responsibilities regulated by the ISM Code. 
1.4.3 主管机关－系指船旗国政府的主管机关。 
Administration: the administrating department of the flag state. 
1.4.4 安全管理体系（SMS）－系指能使公司人员有效执行公司安全及环境保护方针的结构  
化和文件化的体系。 
Safety Management System：a structured and documented system for the company staff to effectively 
implement the safety and environmental protection policy of the company. 
1.4.5 符合证明（DOC）－系指颁发给符合ISM 规则和要求的公司的证明文件。 
Document of Compliance: documents issued to the company that complies with the ISM Code and 
requirements. 
1.4.6 安全管理证书（SMC）—系指颁发给船舶，表明其公司和船舶管理已按照认可的安
全管理体系（SMS）运作的证明文件。 
Safety Management Certificate: Documents issued to the ships to indicate that the company and the 
ships under its management are operated in accordance with the approved safety management system. 
1.4.7 客观证据－系指通过观察、衡量或测试获得并被证实的有关安全或安全管理为体系要 
素的量或质的信息、记录或事实证明。 
Objective Evidence: Information, record or facts about the quantity or quality acquired by observation,

1.4.9 不符合规定的情况－系指客观证据表明的不满足某一具体规定要求的情况。 
Non-Conformity: A situation in which a requirement is not satisfied. 
1.4.10 重大不符合规定的情况－系指对人身或船舶安全构成严重威胁或对环境构成严重危
险，并需要立即采取纠正措施的可辨别的背离，或未能有效和系统地实施ISM 规则。 
Major Non-Conformity: An identifiable breach that may cause severe threat to the safety of human    
beings or ships or hazard to the environment and that need immediate correction or facts that fail to 
effectively and systematically implement the ISM Code. 
1.4.11 周年日－系指对应于有关文件或证书有效期届满之日的每年的该月该日。 
Anniversary Date: the month and date of each year by which the document or certificate is to be 
expired. 
1.4.12 船舶－系指人员或货物的水上交通运输工具，有时亦指船员或船方。 
Ship: a water transportation vessel to carry people or cargo, sometimes also refers to the seafarers or 
ship-owners. 
1.4.13 岸基－系指安全管理体系内岸上人员和部门。 
Shore Base: land personnel and departments within the SMS. 
1.4.14 公司领导－系指总经理等。 
Company Leader: general manager, etc. 
1.4.15 各部门-系指岸基部门，包括船管一部、船管二部、船管三部、船管四部、海务一部、
海务二部、船员部、供应部、体系管理部。对于特定部门，冠以名称，如船舶部门、
政府主管部门等。 
All the departments: shore-base departments, including Fleet 1 Department, Fleet 2 Department, Fleet 
3 Department, Fleet 4 Department, Marine 1 Department, Marine 2 Department ，Crew Department 、
Purchasing Department and ISM Department. For specific department, a name is added, as ship’s 
department, government department etc. 
1.4.16 相关部门、责任部门-系指岸基船管部、海务部、船员部、供应部和体系管理部。 
Relevant and Responsible Departments: shore base Fleet Department, Marine Department, Crew 
Department ， Purchasing Department and ISM Department. 
1.4.17 船舶部门-系指船舶轮机部、甲板部。 
Ship’s Department: Engine and deck departments, etc. 
1.4.18 部门领导-系指岸基船管部经理、海务部经理、船员部经理、供应部经理、体系管理
部经理等。 
Department Leaders: Managers of the shore base Fleet Department, Marine Department, Crew 
Department and Purchasing Department，ISM Department. 
1.4.19 部门长-系指船舶轮机长、大副。 
Department Head: Chief Engineer and Chief Officer, etc. 
1.4.20 船管部-系指船管一部、船管二部、船管三部和船管四部。 
Fleet Department: including Fleet 1 Department, Fleet 2 Department, Fleet 3Department and Fleet 4 
Department.

海运行业组织所建议的适用的规则、指南和标准。 
The company establishes a structured and documented safety management system and composes an 
organic body of organization structure, duties, processes, procedures and resources and continues to 
improve and perfect the system. To ensure that the SMS will identify each process, the company also 
makes relevant procedures and operational instructions to enforce its management. The SMS of the 
company complies with the relevant mandatory rules and regulations (standards) and takes into 
consideration the suitable rules, guidelines and standards suggested by the IMO, administration, 
surveying organizations and shipping organizations. 
1.5.2 制定并实施安全和环境保护方针，要求全体员工贯彻执行，管理层定期评审。 
Establish and implement the safety and environmental protection policy and require the implementation 
and execution among the whole staff and the leaders will conduct regular evaluations. 
1.5.3 确保公司所管理的船舶的安全营运和防止环境污染的所有操作，能够符合有关的规定
和标准的船舶设备操作须知。 
Ensure that the safe shipping and prevention of pollution on the ships under the management of the 
company will follow the ship operational instructions of the relevant regulations and standards. 
1.5.4 明确公司船岸各级人员的职责、权限和相互间的联系渠道。 
Clarify the duties, responsibilities, right and contact channels for the shore base personnel of the 
company. 
1.5.5 建立并实施程序，确保所发生的事故和出现的不符合规定的情况能够及时报告公司，
并采取有效的纠正措施； 
Establish and implement the procedures to ensure that the accidents and non-conformities will be timely 
reported to the company and effective correction measures will be taken. 
1.5.6 建立并实施程序，确保船舶在任何紧急的情况下，能够及时和公司及相关方取得联系，
做好紧急情况的反应和处理工作，并保证措施适当；按照规定定期进行应急演习和训
练，确保船舶在紧急情况发生时，船岸人员能够迅速有效地应对，使损失降低到最小。 
Establish and implement the procedures to ensure that, in any case of emergency, the ship will timely 
contact the company and relevant parties, conduct the emergency response and treatment and ensure 
that the measures taken are suitable. The ship will regularly hold emergency drills and exercises to 
ensure that in case of emergency situations, the ship and shore base personnel will respond immediately 
and effectively so that the losses are minimized to the smallest. 
1.5.7 公司和船舶要定期进行内部审核和有效性评价，必要时进行管理复查，以加强安全管
理体系的监督、检查和评价，确保安全管理体系能够有效的运行并持续改进和完善。 
The company and ships will regularly organize internal audit and effectiveness evaluation, and conduct 
review in necessity to enforce the supervision inspection and evaluation of the SMS and ensure that the 
SMS is implemented effectively and maintains continual improvement and perfection.

第二章 安全和环境保护方针 
Chapter 02 Safety and Environment Protection Policy 
 
2.1 公司为了实现ISM 规则所述“保证海上安全，防止人员伤亡，避免对环境，特别是对
海洋环境造成损害以及对财产造成损失”的目标，认真制定了公司的安全和环保方针。
公司确定并公布的安全和环境保护方针是： 
保证安全，保护环境，保障健康，优质服务 
To achieve the target of “ensure the safety at sea, prevent human injury and avoid the harm to the ocean 
environment and losses to the property” of the IMO, the company makes its policies for safety and 
environmental protection. The company’s policies for safety at sea and environmental protection are as 
follows: 
ENSURE THE SAFETY AT SEA, PROTECT THE SEA ENVIRONMENT, KEEP THE HEALTH 
AND PROVIDE QUALITY SERVICE. 
2.2  管理目标： 
Objective of the management: 
2.2.1 提供船舶安全营运及防污染的安全做法和安全工作环境； 
Provide the method and working environment for safe operation of the ships and environmental 
protection; 
2.2.2 对其船舶、人员及环境已标识的所有风险进行评估并制定适当的防范措施； 
Assess the marked risks to the ships, personnel and environment and make precautionary measures; 
2.2.3 不断提高船岸员工的安全管理技能； 
Improve the safety management techniques of the ship and shore-base staff; 
2.2.4 对各种紧急情况均有应急准备； 
Prepare emergency response against all emergencies; 
2.2.5 不发生责任性海损、机损、污染事故； 
Avoid all the average, engine and pollution accidents; 
2.2.6 防抗台风成功率100％； 
100% success against typhoons; 
2.2.7 人员重伤、死亡率为0； 
Ratio of casualty and serious injury at sea is zero; 
2.2.8 港口国和船旗国检查船舶滞留率为0。 
Ratio of detention in PSC and FSC is zero. 
2.3  管理措施： 
Management measures: 
1) 遵守有关强制性国际规定、规则和国家法律、法令，对建议性规则、指南和标准予以
考虑； 
Follow the mandatory international regulations and rules and national laws and acts and give 
considerations to the suggested rules, guidelines and standards; 
2) 建立、保持和不断改进完善符合ISM 规则要求的安全管理体系； 
Establish, maintain and perfect the SMS that compliance the requirements of ISM Code; 
3) 不断提高员工的安全和环保意识、应急意识和安全管理技能； 
Improve the awareness of safety and environmental protection, emergency awareness and skills in safety 
management; 
4) 培训并激励全体员工熟悉安全管理体系，努力执行公司的有关程序和须知、各司其职、
各尽其责；

第三章 公司的责任和权力 
Chapter 03 Company Responsibilities and Authority 
 
3.1 公司作为船舶管理者(受托方)，与船舶所有人(委托方)签订了符合规定的船舶管理协
议或光租合同（主要内容.1 当安全与防污染同生产、经营、效益发生矛盾时，应当坚
持安全第一和保护环境优先的原则；.2 本规定所有有关安全与防污染的责任和义务由
受托方独立承担；.3 在不妨碍船长履行其职责并独立行使其权力的前提下，受托方对
处理涉及安全与防污染的事务具有最终决定权；.4 委托方应当向受托方提供足够的资
源，确保受托方有效开展船舶安全与防污染管理工作；.5 委托方船舶的船员配备和调
动、船舶及设备维护、应急反应等方面应当服从受托方的指令）。公司保存船舶所有
人向主管机关报告我公司的全称和详细情况的副本。 
As the managing party (entrusted) of the fleet, the company signs agreement with the ship possessor 
(entrusting) concerning the management of the ships and the bareboat chartering. (The main contents 
are: .1 When safety and environmental protection conflict with production, operation, benefits, we shall 
adhere to the principle of safety first and environmental protection priority; .2 All the responsibilities and 
duties of safety and environmental protection under this regulation shall be born by the entrusted; .3 
Where the execution of the captain’s duties and rights are not hindered, the entrusted party has the utmost 
right in the disposal of the accidents concerning the safety and environmental protection; .4 The 
entrusting party shall provide adequate resources for the entrusted to ensure the effective implementation 
of the safety and environmental protection work; .5 The manning, transfer of the crew, the maintenance 
of the ships and equipment and the emergency work of the entrusting party shall abide by the orders of 
the entrusted.) The company will keep the copies of the full name and detailed situations of the company 
that the ship-owner reports to the administration. 
3.2 公司编写了《管理须知手册》，以文件形式明确了管理、执行及审核监控涉及安全和防
污染工作的各个岗位的责任、权力和相互关系，以保证安全管理体系的正常运行。 
The company compiles the “Shore-base Instruction manual” and clarifies the responsibilities, rights and 
the mutual relationship of the positions for the management, execution, evaluation and control of the 
safety and environmental protection work to ensure the effective operation of the SMS. 
3.3 公司要求各部门落实职责，行使职权，加强安全和防污染管理，确保提供足够的资源
和岸基支持，保证指定人员能够有效地履行其职责。 
     The company requires that the department concerned shall implement the duties, execute the rights and 
enforce the management of the safety and environmental protection to ensure the adequate resources 
and shore-base support and that the designated person execute his duties.

第四章 指定人员 
Chapter 04 Designated Person 
 
4.1 公司总经理任命房启涛为指定人员。指定人员向总经理负责，可以就安全和防污染问
题同总经理直接联系，提供岸基和船舶之间的联系渠道，为保证公司安全管理体系的

    The company General Manager appoints Mr. Fang Qitao as the Designated Person. The Designated 
Person shall be responsible to the General Manager and can contact the general manager for safety and 
environmental protection matters. He will also provide a link between ships and shore-base department 
to ensure the facilitation, implementation, control and inspection for the effectiveness of the SMS and 
ensure the safe operation of each ship. 
4.2 指定人员的主要职责如下： 
The responsibilities of the designated person are as follows: 
4.2.1 对公司的安全管理体系及船岸的安全和防污染工作进行监控； 
 Monitoring on the SMS of the company and the safety and environmental protection both on ships and 
shore; 
4.2.2 确保向船舶提供足够的资源和岸基支持； 
 Ensure to provide adequate resources and shore base support; 
4.2.3 保证安全管理体系的有效实施； 
Ensure the effective implementation of the SMS; 
4.2.4 监督、检查文件管理、不符合规定的情况处置等体系管理活动； 
   Control and inspect the system management activities as the document management and the disposal of 
the non-conformities; 
4.2.5 组织内部审核和筹备有效性评价和/或管理复查，确保纠正措施的实施； 
   Organize the internal audit and prepare the effectiveness evaluate or management review to ensure the 
implementation of the correction measures; 
4.2.6 保持船舶与公司高层领导之间的联系畅通。 
   Maintain the communication between the ships and the top leaders of the company; 
4.2.7 负责安全管理体系方面的对外联络和体系的内外审核。 
   Be responsible for the external contact and the internal and external audit concerning the SMS matters; 
4.2.8 向总经理报告所观察到的安全管理体系的重大情况。 
   Report to the general manager the major facts observed concerning the SMS matters. 
4.3 指定人员的主要权力如下： 
    The authority of the designated person are as follows: 
4.3.1 涉及安全和防污染方面任何问题  均可向公司总经理报告。

   Appoint the group leader of the internal audit; 
4.3.3 对体系内人员的任免有建议权; 
   Make suggestions concerning the appointment of the personnel within the SMS; 
4.3.4 对船岸的安全和防污染管理活动有监控权。 
Superintendence the management activities of safety and environmental protection of ship and 
shore-base departments. 
4.4 指定人员的替代关系 
    Substitute of the Designated Person. 
    指定人员不在工作岗位时，其安全管理职责由总经理替代。

01_20.text:
第五章 船长的责任和权力 
Chapter 05 Master’s Responsibilities and Authority 
 
5.1 船长的责任 
   Responsibilities of the Master: 
   船长在公司船上任职期间，除按公司指示行使船舶经营和管理权外，还要履行以下职责： 
In his position as Master onboard the ship under the company’s management, in addition to his implementation 
of operation and management of the ship , he will also be responsible for the following: 
5.1.1 执行公司的安全和环境保护方针； 
  Implementing the safety and environmental protection policies of the company; 
5.1.2 采用教育、培训、考核奖惩等方法，激励船员遵守公司的安全和环境保护方针，提高安全
管理技能； 
Motivating crew to follow the safety and environmental protection policies of the company and to improve the 
safety management skills by means of education, training, assessment, rewards and punishment, etc; 
5.1.3 依据体系文件，以简明的方式向船员发布命令和指令，指导安全管理体系在船上的运行； 
In accordance with the SMS documents, Issuing order and instructions to the crew in a clear and simple manner 
to maintain the implementation of the SMS onboard; 
5.1.4 核查（查验、检查）各种规定的具体要求得到遵守的情况和体系文件执行的过程，以便发
现不符合规定的情况，对体系运行实施监控。每半年评价船舶体系运行情况，并以“船舶安
全管理体系运行情况监控报告”形式报告公司。 
Verify(inspect and check) the practice of the regulations and the execution of the SMS to find a 
non-conformities and control the implementation of the SMS. Conduct a Evaluation to the implementation of 
SMS on board ever a half year and report to the company in the form of Safety Management System supervisory 
Report On Board 
5.1.5 根据船舶的安全管理体系的实际运行情况，复查安全管理体系，审视安全管理体系是否存
在问题，并按要求向公司岸基管理部门报告其存在的缺陷和整改措施。 
On basis of the practical implementation of the SMS onboard, periodically reviewing the SMS to find out 
whether there are still problems in existence and report to the shore-base management departments defects and 
correction measures; 
5.1.6 按照文件控制要求，对船舶的安全管理体系文件进行管理和控制。 
In accordance with  requirements of document control, conduct management and control of the SMS 
documents onboard.   
5.2 船长绝对权力的声明 
    Declaration of the overriding authority of the Master: 
    根据国际海事组织A.443（11）号决议《关于船长在海上安全和海洋环境保护方面的决定》，
公司总经理就船长的绝对权力声明如下： 
船长有绝对权力采取一切必要的措施和决定性行动，保证航行安全，维护船上秩序，防止船
员及其他人员受到伤害，保护本船和/或其它船舶财产免受损失以及防止污染水域环境。船
长根据专业判断在这方面做出的必要决定不受船东、租船人或任何其他人员的约束，尤应受
到国内法律、共同协议或雇佣合同中适当规定的保护,使其不致因正当执行其专业决定而遭
到不公正的对待。船长可以在任何时候要求公司有关人员提供必要的援助以完成其任务，公
司应从人力、物力和财力各个方面给予充分支持。 
公司支持船长有效地履行职责，行使绝对权力，船员必须服从船长的指挥。

第六章 资源和人员 
Chapter 06 Resource and Personnel 
 
6.1 船长是船舶实施安全和防污染管理的主要责任人。公司建立并实施《船长和船员的审
核调配程序》，确定“船长适当指挥资格”的标准和考核办法，对聘用的船长进行考察
和控制，保证派往船舶工作的船长具有相应的任职资格（包括具有适当的指挥资格）
和主管机关签发或认可的有效船长证书。船长在上船之前接受公司安全管理体系文件
的培训并保证足够的时间，确保船长完全熟悉公司的安全管理体系。公司保证船长在
船工作期间得到必要的支持，以使其可靠地履行职责，完成任务。 
The captain takes the main responsibility in the implementation of safety and environmental protection. 
The company establishes and implements the “Procedure for the Verifying and Manning to Captain and 
Crew” to determine the standards and assessment of the “Captain’s qualifications in giving directions” to 
conduct examinations and control of the captain and ensure that the captain entrusted has the 
corresponding qualifications (including his qualifications in giving directions) and that he holds the valid 
certificate issued or approved by the administration. The captain will receive SMS document training in 
an adequate period of time before getting onboard to ensure that he is totally familiar with the SMS. The 
company will ensure that the captain will get necessary support in his duration onboard so that he will 
dependably execute his duties in the completion of his tasks. 
6.2 公司根据《船长和船员的审核调配程序》，聘用符合有关要求的合格、持证，并且身
体健康的船员，确保每艘船舶最低配员数额符合有关规定要求。保证派到船舶工作的
所有船员具有他们服务船舶的主管机关签发或认可的相应证书，并保持在船工作期间
适用和有效。聘用的船员经过符合STCW 公约要求的培训,经考核能胜任本职工作。拟
派上船时，船员必须持有有效的健康证明，还要按规定接受预防接种注射。 
    In accordance with the Captain and Crew Assignment Evaluation Procedure and the company will 
employ those in compliance with the requirements of qualifications, certifications and health, and ensure 
the number of crew on each ship is no less than the requirement of crew minimum manning certificate. 
The company will ensure that the seafarers manned will hold the corresponding certificates issued or 
approved by the administration that are suitable for the ships they work on, valid and effective in their 
service period. The seafarers employed have received training in respect of the STCW Convention and 
are proved qualified for the positions. When manned, the seafarers will hold the effective health 
certificates and will be duly immunized in accordance with the requirements. 
6.3 公司建立并实施《人力资源控制程序》和《船员培训控制程序》,以保证新聘及调至
新岗位的船岸人员在任职前进行培训，使其熟悉其职责并能胜任其担负的工作。公司
已把安全管理体系文件和船舶资料配船。开航前需要发出的重要指令，是针对接班船
员熟悉职责提出的要求，是确保其熟悉职责的具体措施之一。由公司根据实际情况确
定范围和内容并予以标识，以书面形式发出,要求新上船人员熟悉开航前须知，确保
其担任职务所进行的操作正确性。 
    The company establishes and implements the Human Resources Control Procedure and Crew Training 
Control Procedure to ensure that the newly employed and transferred ship and shore-base staff receive 
relevant training before they come to the positions so that they are familiar with their duties and 
responsibility for the positions. The company has issued the SMS and ship particulars onboard. The 
important orders given before sailing are the requests for the taking over officers for their familiarization 
of their responsibilities and are one of the measures to ensure their familiarization, whose scope and 
contents will be duly recognized by the company, based on the practical situations and will be issued in 
the written form so that the new staff are familiar with the instructions prior sailing and ensure correct 
operation in their positions.

6.5 公司建立并实施《人力资源控制程序》和《船员培训控制程序》，定期征询培训需求、
制定培训计划，以标识实施安全管理体系所需要的培训，保证将这些培训提供给体系
内所有相关人员，并达到预期的培训效果。 
    The company establishes and implements the Human Resources Control Procedure and Crew Training 
Control Procedure and will regularly request the training demand and make the training plans to 
recognize the necessary training of the SMS to ensure that the trainings have been provided to all the 
relevant staff within the system and have achieved the expected results. 
6.6 公司建立并实施《信息传递、交流程序》，保证在船工作的船员能够获得以中文或英
文传递的有关安全管理体系最新信息（尤其指公司安全管理体系运行情况的信息及外
界安全和防止污染管理的动向），保持这些信息在执行者之间互相传递。要求他们提
高相互沟通的汉语（包括地方语）表达能力，高级船员要提高英语水平，以便其履行
安全职责时能够有效交流，更好地适应其工作要求。 
    The company establishes and implements the Delivery & Exchange of Communication Procedure to 
ensure that the seafarers onboard have the access to the latest SMS information in Chinese or English 
(especially that concerning the operation of the SMS and the development of safety and environmental 
protection) and that the information will go round the executors. The company will require that they 
improve their language expression capabilities and officers will improve their English level for their 
effective communication in their safety duties and adaptability to their positions.

01_22.chapter: 第七章 船上操作方案的制订
01_22.text:
第七章 船上操作方案的制订 
Chapter 07 Shipboard Operations Establishment 
 
7.1 对涉及人员、船舶安全和防止污染的关键性的船上操作，公司制定了有关程序、方案
或须知包括必要的检查清单。与之相关的各项工作，明确规定并分配给适任人员。为
了对涉及安全和防污染管理活动的所有船上操作和管理过程进行有效地控制，防止因
操作不当而发生事故、险情和不符合规定的情况，公司建立并实施《船上操作方案的
制定程序》，要求按照有关的规定、规则、标准、指南和船上设备的实际操作，制定并
不断完善各种操作方案和/或须知及需要的检查清单，明确规定如何制定船上操作方案
和/或须知及需要的检查清单及由适任的人员承担制定操作方案和/或须知及需要的检
查清单的任务。对于新增或修改操作方案和须知、检查清单，执行《船上操作方案的
制定程序》。加强对船舶执行操作方案和须知的监督和检查，提供船舶安全做法和工作
环境。明确各项操作方案的执行，分配给持有相应岗位证书的适任的人员来完成。 
    In correspondence to the key operations that concern the safety of personnel and the ship and 
environmental protection, the company has made relevant procedures, plans and instructions, including 
the necessary checklists and the relevant work has been clarified and distributed to the suitable personnel. 
For the effective control of the operation and management of the activities concerning safety and 
environmental protection and for the prevention of the accidents, dangers and non-conformities incurred 
by the misconduct, the company establishes and implements the Shipboard operations plan development 
Procedure and requests that, in accordance with the relevant rules, regulations, standards, guidelines and 
the practical operation of the equipment onboard, various operational plans and/or instructions and 
necessary checklists be made and perfected, the making of the operational plans and/or instructions and 
necessary checklists be clarified and the tasks hereof be made by suitable personnel. The execution of 
the operational plans shall be clarified and distributed to suitable certificate holders. Added or revised 
operation plans, instructions and check lists also should abide by the Shipboard operations plan 
development Procedure. Enhance the supervision and inspection on the implementation of operational 
plans and instructions onboard; ensure a safety practice and working environment on board. The 
execution of the operational plans shall be clarified and distributed to suitable certificate holders. 
7.2 公司已对影响安全和防止污染的临界操作和特殊操作进行标识。涉及的操作程序、须
知已形成文件。这些程序、须知充分考虑到国际、国内的有关规定和要求，并参照了
各行业组织所制定的有关技术标准和指南。船长要组织各级船员严格按照程序和须知
的要求进行操作，按规定做好记录。 
    The company has recognized the operations that may impact the safety and environmental protection and 
those special operations and the critical operational procedures and instructions have been documented. 
The making of the procedures and instructions has been taken into consideration the national and 
international regulations and requirements and has referred to the technical standards and guidelines 
made by the industrial organizations. The captain shall organize the crew members to strictly follow the 
procedures and instructions in their operation and make detailed records as per necessary.

第八章 应急准备 
Chapter 08 Emergency Preparedness 
 
8.1 对于船上可能出现的紧急情况，公司予以标示并制定了《应急计划》，标示了船舶可能
出现结构损坏、船舶失控（推进系统故障、电站故障、舵设备或舵系统故障）、碰撞、
搁浅、触礁、货物移动、货物散漏或污染、火灾、进水、弃船、救助、进入封闭场所
救助、人员严重受伤、暴力或海盗袭击、恶劣天气损害、网络攻击等紧急情况；制定
了船舶碰撞（结构损坏、进水等）、船舶搁浅、船舶火灾（爆炸）、恶劣天气损害、船
员危重伤和重病、弃船、主机失灵/电源损坏、舵机失灵、船舶溢油事故、进入封闭处
所预防和救助、人落水、海盗或暴力事件、货物移动、网络攻击等紧急情况的应急措
施（或称应急计划、应急预案），指导船岸应急处理，做出应急反应。公司与船舶具有
每天保持24 小时联络的畅通渠道。对于委托管理的船舶，与船舶所有人签定的《船舶
管理协议》明确规定了“委托方船舶在应急反应方面服从受托方的指令”。 
For the emergencies that may arise onboard, the company has made the Contingence Plan and has 
recognized the emergency situations as structural failure, not under control (propeller trouble, power 
station failure, steering gear or system failures), collision, grounding, stranding, cargo shift, cargo leakage 
or pollution, fire, flooding, abandon ship, salvage, entry enclosed spaces, human injuries, violence or 
piracy，severe weathers and cyber attacks etc., made the emergency responses to the situations of collision 
(structural damage and flooding, etc), grounding, fire (explosion), severe weathers, serious injury and 
diseases, abandoning, main engine failure/power blackout, steering gear failure, oil spill, entry enclosed 
spaces for salvage, man overboard, piracy or violence, cargo shift, cyber attacks etc., to guide the 
emergency reaction and treatment. The company keeps 24 hours contact with the ships. For the 
Agreement for the Management of Ships signed with the ship-owners for the entrusted ships and, 
clarification is also made of “Orders to be followed by the entrusted ships in case of emergency 
situations.” 
8.2 公司建立并实施《应急计划》，对已标识的紧急情况，参照应急预案，制定应急行动训
练和演习计划及船岸联合应急演习。通过训练和演习，增强船岸人员应付紧急情况的
信心和能力。船舶配备《训练手册》。 
    The company establishes and implements the Contingency Plan and has made the emergency exercises, 
drill plans and ship-shore joint exercises against the recognized emergencies and in reference to the 
emergency responses. By means of exercises and drills, the confidence and capabilities in coping with 
emergency situations has been greatly increased. The ships are equipped with the Training manual. 
8.3 公司的安全管理体系制定相关的程序和措施，提供足够的资源和岸上支持。公司制定
的岸上应急预案，使岸基人员和船上人员在任何时候能够对船舶所遇到的危险、各种
紧急情况和事故迅速、有效地做出反应，合理处置。为了提高船岸人员应急反应能力
和协调，定期进行船舶应急演习、岸基应急训练和船岸联合应急演习。 
    The company has made relevant procedures and measures within the SMS to provide adequate resources 
and shore-base support. The company has develop the emergency response for shore-base departments so 
that both shore-base and ship staff will make prompt and effective responses and organize reasonable 
treatment in any case of the dangers and emergency situations. To improve the emergency response 
abilities and facilitations of the shore-base and ship staff, the company will regularly organize emergency 
exercises, shore base emergency drill and ship-shore joint emergency exercises. 
8.4 公司建立并实施《风险评估程序》，对已标识的船舶、人员及环境的所有风险进行评估。

01_24.chapter: 第九章 不符合规定的情况、事故和险情的报告和分析
01_24.text:
第九章 不符合规定的情况、事故和险情的报告和分析 
Chapter 09 Reports and Analysis of Non-conformities,  
Accidents and Hazardous Occurrences 
 
9.1 公司建立并实施《不符合规定的情况、事故和险情的报告和分析程序》，以便改进安全
和防污染方面的工作。船舶发生的不符合规定的情况、事故和险情均要按程序报告公
司，报告要包括其详细情况和发生的可能原因及改进措施。公司收到上述报告后要在
相应的管理层对其进行分析、调查和处置，并报告至总经理。调查和分析要注重以下
方面：责任者是否熟悉其职责；是否具备适任资格；是否经过相关培训；是否了解SMS
规定的程序和须知；对SMS 规定的程序和须知的背离程度；当时的工作环境及客观条
件等。 
The company establishes and implements the Report and handling procedure of Non-Conformities, 
Accidents and Hazardous Occurrences for the improvement of the safety and environmental reported to 
the company in accordance with the procedures and the report shall include the protection work. The 
non-conformities, accidents and hazards that take place onboard shall be details, possible reasons and 
improvement measures. On receiving the report, the company shall organize analysis, investigations and 
treatment at relevant levels of the managers, and report the result to the general manager. Cautions shall 
be made in the investigations and analysis: whether the person responsible is familiar with the his duties, 
whether he is qualified, whether he has been trained in the due respect, whether he knows the SMS 
regulations and instructions, the extent to which he violates the SMS regulations and instructions, the 
situations and objective conditions when the accidents take place, etc. 
9.2 公司建立并实施《不符合规定的情况、事故和险情的报告和处理程序》和《预防措施
程序》，包括避免不符合规定情况、事故、险情重复发生的措施。通过对已出现的或潜
在的不符合规定的情况、事故或险情进行调查、分析，确定并实施可能采取的纠正或
预防措施，并对纠正或预防措施的实施效果进行确认，以保证纠正措施或预防措施得
以落实，从根本上提高和改进安全和防止污染管理工作。必要时，纠正措施包括在公
司内部进行沟通及对现有的安全管理体系文件进行修改或增加。 
The company establishes and implements the Report and handling procedure of Non-Conformities, 
Accidents and Hazardous Occurrences and Prevention/Corrective Measures Procedures, including the 
measures to prevent the repetition of the non-conformities, accidents and hazards occurrences. By means 
of the correction or preventive measures concerning the investigations and analysis of the 
non-conformities, accidents and hazards either apparent or potential, the company shall determine and 
implement the correction or preventive measures and recognize the result of the measures to ensure that 
the measures are implemented and that safety and environmental protection work is improved and 
perfected. When necessary, the correction measures will be communicated within the company and the 
current SMS documents of safety and environmental protection will be revised. 
9.3 当船舶发生事故、重大险情时，在保证安全的情况下，公司要尽快向船旗国所在地的
海事管理机构报告；若危及航行安全及防污染情况时，应立即向就近港口国报告；对
于安全管理体系运行过程中发生的重大事项要及时向公司所在地的直属海事管理机构
报告； 
In case of accidents and major hazards occurrences, where safety is ensured, the company shall report to 
the maritime administration of the flag state as soon as possible. In case the accidents threat the safety and 
environmental protection, report shall be immediately submitted to the nearest port state. The major 
events that take place in the operation of the SMS report shall be made to the maritime administration of 
the location of the company.

第十章 船舶和设备的维护 
Chapter 10 Maintenance of the Ship and Equipment 
 
10.1 公司建立并实施《船舶预防性维护保养程序》，要求船舶按照有关的规定、船级社规
范、船旗国检查规则、港口国检查要求和公司的相关规定对船舶和设备进行维护，以
保证船舶和设备的可靠性，确保船舶处于安全状态并适航适货。 
The company establishes and implements the Ship Preventive Maintenance Procedures and requires that 
regular maintenance to the ship and its equipment shall be conducted, in accordance with the 
requirements and regulations of the class societies, flag state port state inspections and the company, to 
ensure the dependability of the ship and its equipment and that the ship is in a state of safety, 
seaworthiness and cargo worthiness.  
10.2 公司在船上实行计划维护保养。船舶在年底制定下年度的维护保养计划，报公司批准
后实施，确保按规定的适当间隔期限对船舶和设备进行检查测量，公司船管部组织对
船舶维护工作进行监督检查；对于已知的设备的不符合规定的情况（由于维护保养不
当造成的缺陷）要及时报告并分析、查找原因，采取适当的纠正措施。要保存上述活
动的相关记录（包括主管机关或船舶检验机构要求的法定检验报告和证书、日常维护
报告和检查记录、船舶和设备缺陷情况和纠正及预防措施的实施情况等）。 
The company shall conduct planned maintenance and repair to the ship. The annual maintenance plan  
shall be made by the end of the year and reported to the company for approval before implementation to 
ensure that checks and measurements of the ship and its equipment are made at regular intervals. The 
fleet department shall organize supervision and checks to the maintenance of the ship. For the known 
non-conformities of the equipment (defects due to failure of maintenance), timely report, analysis and 
trouble-shooting shall be made and suitable correction measures shall be rendered. Records of the above 
going activities shall be kept (including the mandatory inspection reports and certificates required by the 
administration or ship survey society, routine maintenance reports and survey records, deficits of the ship 
and its equipment, implementation of the correction and preventive measures, etc.) 
10.3 根据有关方面的要求和船舶状况，公司对船舶实施航修、厂修和坞修。 
In accordance with the requirements of the interested parties and status of the ship, the company conducts 
voyage, yard and dock repair to the ship. 
10.4 公司建立并实施《关键性设备和系统标识程序》,标识那些会因突发性运行故障而导
致险情的设备和技术系统。安全管理体系提供了旨在提高这些设备和系统可靠性的具
体措施。这些措施应当包括对备用装置及设备或非连续使用的技术系统的定期测试和
对应急设备定期检查和试验，包括这些设备在突然失灵时启用替代装置。 
The company establishes and implements the Shipboard Critical Equipment & System Identifying 
Procedure to identify the equipment and technical systems that may be threatened on account of the 
accidents. The SMS provides concrete measures to be taken with the aim of improving the dependability 
of the equipment and systems. They should include the regular tests to the standby equipments and 
non-continued usage technical systems and the inspection and tests to the emergency equipment and also 
included shall be the substitution of them in case of a sudden failure. 
10.5 船上人员在船舶的日常操作性维护工作中，要纳入第10.2 节所述的检查和第10.4 节
所述的措施，按照规定实施维修保养计划，并保存实施记录。岸基要为船舶提供必要
的资源和支持。 
The routine operation and maintenance shall be included the measures stated in section 10.2 and 10.4. 
The shipboard personnel shall implement the maintenance and repair plans in accordance with the 
regulations and keep the records. Shore-base departments shall provide the necessary resources and

第十一章 文件 
Chapter 11 Documentation 
 
11.1 公司建立和保持《体系文件控制程序》、《外来文件控制程序》和《记录控制程序》，
对与安全管理体系有关的所有文件（内部文件和外来文件）和资料进行有效控制。内
部文件的控制内容包括：编写、会签、审核、批准、发放、保管、修改、废除等；外
来文件的控制内容包括：跟踪（通过信息交流）、确认、配备和使用最新有效版本等。 
The company establishes and maintains the SMS Document Control Procedure, External Document 
Control Procedure and Record Control Procedure to perform effective control of the documents (internal 
and external) and materials within the SMS. The control of the internal documents include, compiling, 
signing, audit, approval, issuance, keeping, revising and abolishing, etc and that of the external 
documents include, tracking (by means of information exchange), confirmation, distribution and using of 
the latest editions.   
11.2 公司保证做到： 
The company shall ensure the following: 
11.2.1 体系内所有部门和船舶均能够获得与安全和防污染管理活动有关的有效的文件；保
持文件是最新版本和有效性。 
The effective documents concerning the safety and environmental protection shall be available to the 
departments and ships within the system and the documents shall be the latest edition and effective. 
11.2.2 文件发布前要经指定人员审核、总经理批准； 
The documents shall be evaluated by the Designated Person and approved by the General Manager before 
issuance. 
11.2.3 文件的修改要经指定人员授权，执行和原文件相同的批准程序。更改可采用换页、
修改页或换版的方式进行并发文件发布实施，被废止的文件要及时清除并做好记录。 
The revising of the documents shall be authorized by the Designated Person and the execution shall be 
identical in the approval. The revising of the documents shall be in the form of page change, revision or 
version change before issuance and implementation. The documents abolished shall be timely removed 
and duly recorded.  
11.3 对涉及安全和防污染的外来文件，公司编入《外来文件总清单》。按清单配备并执行
外来文件。 
For the external documents concerning the safety and environmental protection shall be incorporated into 
the List of the External Documents. Documents shall be provided as per the List and executed.  
11.4 文件持有人要按《体系文件控制程序》的要求，有效地保持和管理体系文件。公司编
制《体系文件总清单》，标明文件的名称、编号、责任部门、配备要求等，并根据文件
修改情况及时更换。与船舶有关的安全管理体系文件已配发并保存在船上。 
The keeper of the documents shall effectively keep and maintain the documents in accordance with the 
requirements of the SMS Document Control Procedure, External Document Control Procedure. The 
company complied the General Content of the SMS Documents for indicating the file titles, file numbers, 
department in charge, equipment requirement etc. and replaced timely as per Document Modification 
Notice. Those SMS documents are distributed to and kept onboard. 
11.5 船上操作方案由船舶按照船上实际操作情况进行编写，公司予以协助。 
The ship onboard operations shall be compiled by personnel of vessel as per the practical instruction 
onboard and assisted by the company. 
11.6 《安全管理手册》是依据ISM 规则编写，用于阐述和实施公司安全管理体系的文件，
详细阐述公司的安全和环保方针、机构设置、指定人员和关于船长的权力声明等，并

01_27.text:
第十二章 公司审核、复查和评价 
Chapter 12 Company Verification, Review and Evaluation 
 
12.1 内部审核 
     Internal audits 
   公司建立并实施《管理体系内部审核程序》,在不超过12 个月的间隔期内对船上及岸
基实施内部审核，以核查安全和防止污染活动是否符合安全管理体系的要求。特殊情
况下，间隔期不应超过15 个月,如需延迟时应将延迟情况予以说明，报经指定人员和
总经理批准。 
通过内部审核及时发现问题并采取纠正和/或预防措施使安全管理体系不断完善、持
续改进。通过内部审核为主管机关或其认可的认证机构的审核（外部审核）做好准备。
内部审核的内容包括：内部审核的策划或计划、实施、内部审核报告、验证纠正措施
的实施情况、保存内部审核记录等。内部审核的结果是有效性评价的输入。实施内部
审核的人员要由不从属于被审核方的人员担任。 
The company establishes and carry out SMS Internal Audit Procedure. The Company should carry out 
internal audits to ship and ashore-base at intervals not exceeding twelve months to verify whether safety 
and pollution-prevention activities comply with the SMS requirement. In exceptional circumstances, 
this interval may be exceeded by not more than three months and must be give approve by DP or 
General Manager. 
The purpose of the internal audit lies in that the problems are found and corrective and preventive 
measures are taken to further improve and perfect the SMS. It is also a preparation for the external audit 
by the administration or organizations authorized hereby. The contents of the internal audit include: the 
design or plan, implementation, report, verification of the corrective measures and the keeping of the 
internal audit records, etc. The result of the internal audit is the input of the effectiveness evaluation. 
The auditors shall be those who do not belong to the department to be verified. 
12.2 有效性评价和管理复查 
     Effectiveness Evaluation and Management Review  
 公司建立并实施《管理体系定期评价和复查程序》，按规定的间隔时间（不超过12 个
月）对安全管理体系进行有效性评价。有效性评价包括由公司总经理主持召开的有效
性评价会议和船长在船工作每半年应就安全管理体系运行情况进行有效性评价。公司
在安全管理体系有效性评价的基础上认为必要时或体系运行需要时，要对安全管理体
系进行管理复查。管理复查由总经理主持。船舶每半年由船长组织高级船员召开体系
运行评价会议，就本船体系运行情况进行一次体系评价，结合有效性评价并以《船舶
安全管理体系运行情况监控报告》的形式上报公司。 
The company establishes and implements the SMS Regular Evaluation and Review Procedure and 
conducts effectiveness evaluations in intervals (no less than 12 months) to the SMS. The effectiveness 
evaluation shall include the evaluation meetings organized by the General Manager and the evaluation 
made by the captain every half year. When rendered necessary on basis of the evaluation of the SMS or 
when necessary for the operation of the SMS, the company shall conduct management review to the 
SMS and it is organized by the General Manager. The evaluation meeting should be organized by the 
captain and held among the officers and engineers every half year. Ship SMS Implementation 
Monitoring Report should be completed to the company according to the evaluation made on the system 
operation state. 
12.3 纠正措施 
     Corrective measures

The internal audit, effectiveness evaluation and management review reports will be issued after the 
approval of the Designated Person and the General Manager, and the result will be informed to the 
responsible persons of the relevant departments and ships for their due attention. The responsible 
persons shall make and implement corrective measures to the problems found in the evaluations in 
accordance with the Internal Audit Non-Conformity Report. The auditor will follow the implementation 
of the corrective measures to further improvement and perfection of the SMS and prevention of the 
repetition of the non-conformities and deficits. 
12.4 公司的内部审核、有效性评价、管理复查及可能采取的纠正措施均制定了文件规定的
程序，并要求按照程序实施。 
The company has made documented procedures for the internal audit, effectiveness evaluation and 
management review and requires due implementation.  
12.5 安全管理体系监控 
  Control of the SMS 
      为了保证安全管理体系活动的有效性、符合性、持续性，加强安全管理体系运行的监
控，要求各部门和船舶结合体系的定期有效性评价，向指定人员报告体系运行情况，
以提高各部门和船舶运行安全管理体系的自觉性，增强指定人员的监控力度，同时，
为有效性评价提供依据。 
To ensure the effectiveness, compliance and sustainability of the SMS activities and to enforce the 
control of the SMS operation, the company requires that, in combination with the regular effectiveness 
evaluation, the ship and shore-base departments shall report the operation of the system to the 
Designated Person to improve the awareness, enforce the control of the Designated Person and to 
provide evidence for the effectiveness evaluation.

01_28.text:
第十三章 发证和定期审核 
Chapter 13 Certification and Periodical Verification 
 
13.1 符合证明 
     Document of Compliance 
公司按照ISM 规则要求，建立并运行安全管理体系，通过主管机关或其认可机构的
认证审核，取得并保持符合证明（DOC），符合证明的副本将提供给每艘船舶的船长，
以便出示供主管机关或其认可的机构验证。 
The company establishes and implements the SMS in accordance with the requirements of the ISM 
Code and will acquire and maintain the Document of Compliance(DOC) by means of the accreditation 
verification of the Administration or by an organization recognized by the Administration. The copy will 
be provided to the captains of each of the ships for the verification of the Administration or by an 
organization recognized by the Administration.   
13.2 安全管理证书 
     Safety Management Certificate(SMC) 
公司管理的每艘船舶均按照ISM 规则的要求，有效地运行安全管理体系，通过主管
机关或其认可机构的认证审核，取得并保持安全管理证书（SMC），证书的副本由公
司负责管理。 
Each of the ships under the management of the company is effectively implement the SMS in 
accordance with the requirements of the ISM Code. The SMC is required by means of the accreditation 
verification of the Administration or by an organization recognized by the Administration. and the 
copies are managed by the company. 
13.3 为了保持证书的有效性，公司(体系管理部)将按符合证明/或安全管理证书的到期日，
向认证机构及时申请相应的审核（包括年度审核、中间审核、换证审核、附加审核等），
岸基和船舶对主管机关或其认可机构的审核要积极地予以配合。 
     To maintain the effectiveness of the certificates, the company (ISM department) will apply to an 
organization recognized by the Administration for relevant verification (including annual, intermediate, 
renewal and additional verification) as per the expiration date of the DOC and SMC.

第十四章 临时证书 
Chapter 14 Interim Certification 
 
14.1 临时符合证明 
     Interim Document of Compliance(DOC) 
当公司增加新的船舶种类营运时,制定并实施满足ISM 规则全部要求的安全管理体系
的计划，向主管机关申请临时审核 ,核发有效期不超过12 个月的“临时符合证明”。
新增加的船舶保存一份“临时符合证明”的副本，以便船长在接受主管机关或其认可
的机构查验时出示。 
When new types of ships are joined company’s management, SMS Development and Implementation 
shall be compliance with the requirements of the ISM Code and application shall be made for interim 
verification to the administration for the Interim DOC with a validity not exceeding 12 months. A copy 
will be kept on the new ship for verification of the Administration or the Organizations Authorized by 
Administration.  
14.2 临时安全管理证书 
     Interim Safety Management Certificate(SMC) 
当公司增加新的船舶经营管理时,要向主管机关或其认可的机构申请船舶临时审核，
核发有效期不超过6 个月（特殊情况下，可做出不超过6 个月的展期）的“临时安全
管理证书”。审核前公司要做到： 
When new ships are joined company’s management, application shall be made to the administration or 
the Organizations Authorized by Administration for interim verification and for “Interim SMC” with a 
validity not exceeding 6 months (for special cases and extension can be made not exceeding 6 months). 
Prior to verification, the company shall make sure that: 
14.2.1 “符合证明”或“临时符合证明”覆盖了该船舶种类； 
 “DOC” or “Interim DOC” covers the ship types;  
14.2.2 已向船舶提供了包含规则的关键要素的安全管理体系文件，并且该文件在为发放符合
证明的审核中评估过或为发放临时符合证明时出示过； 
Have provided the SMS documents including the key elements and the documents shall have been 
assessed in the DOC or Interim DOC verification; 
14.2.3 安全管理体系已在船舶有效运行； 
SMS has been effectively implemented on the ship;  
14.2.4 已制定三个月内对该船实施内部审核的计划； 
SMS Implement Plan is developed for the ship within three months; 
14.2.5 船长和高级船员已熟悉公司的安全管理体系及其实施的计划安排； 
The captain and officers are familiar with the SMS and the plans and arrangements for its 
implementation; 
14.2.6 标识为重要的指令已在开航前下达。 
The important marked instructions have been given prior to sailing; 
14.2.7 与安全管理体系相关的信息以船员懂得的语言提供。 
The information concerning the SMS has been provided to the crew members in the language that they 
understand.

Chapter 15 Verification

船舶的所有审核依据《国际安全管理规则》、 安全管理体系、发证机关的相关规则、
规范，及船旗国的规定。 
All the audits on ships are based on the regulations of the ISM Code, SMS, the rules, standards and

Chapter 16 Forms of Certificates 
 
16.1 对于 “符合证明”、“安全管理证书”、“临时符合证明”和“临时安全管理证书”要
认真复核，确保准确无误。 
Checks shall be made carefully to the “DOC,” “SMC,” “Interim DOC” and “Interim SMC” to ensure 
accuracy. 
16.2 核对“符合证明”、“临时符合证明”中所载明的船舶种类加以签注的限制是否符合公

“Interim DOC” comply with the ship types.
